themes.evidence: Design, build, and maintain the data models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that give the commercial org clear, trusted visibility
Implement operational improvements end-to-end: design + drive adoption + measure impact
Translate commercial problems into well-defined briefs that Product and Engineering can act on
Experience working cross-functionally with Product/Engineering, with technical fluency
Map, challenge, and rebuild core commercial workflows ... into cleaner, faster, scalable ways of working
Proficiency in SQL + hands-on with BI/data tools (Looker, Tableau, or BigQuery)

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is building data models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks on SQL/BI tools (Looker, Tableau, BigQuery) to give the commercial org KPI visibility — core analytics-engineering work despite the 'Strategy & Analytics Manager' title.
notes: The 'NL→SQL' tag is a loose fit — the JD names SQL and BI tools heavily but never mentions natural-language-to-SQL specifically; it was the closest data/SQL theme in the vocab. AI is framed as an accelerant for the analyst's own workflow (not agent-building), so agents/LLM-orchestration were deliberately excluded.
